name: agent-shipproof
description: Record portable evidence of observed commands, files, and Git state.

interface.longDescription: Agent ShipProof creates a deterministic Observed Evidence Envelope from command results, selected file hashes, Git state, environment facts, and explicit omissions. It records observations without claiming correctness, security, identity, authorization, certification, or sandboxing.
defaultPrompt: Record an evidence receipt for this agent run.
Produce a receipt from these command logs and selected files.
Show a GitHub Actions example using ShipProof.
